icon.description: Material Symbols Rounded icon name, e.g. "rocket_launch". Browse: https://fonts.google.com/icons

email.description: Leave empty to hide all email buttons.

banner.description: File in /public. Missing files show a tonal placeholder.

pfp.description: File in /public. Missing files show a monogram placeholder.

enabled.description: Show the LED visor anywhere on the site.

showInAppBar.description: Show the tiny visor next to your name in the top bar.

greeting.description: Text that scrolls across the visor on load. Letters, numbers and basic punctuation.

source.description: "pfp": build the Material You colors from your profile picture (PNG), like Android does from a wallpaper. "seed": use `seed` below.

seed.description: Theme color when source is "seed", or if the pfp can't be read.

wallpapers.description: Extra "Basic colors" visitors can pick in the palette menu. Use [] to only offer your pfp colors.

featurePinned.description: Featured carousel = the repos pinned on your GitHub profile, fetched at build time. Only used when the top-level `featured` list is empty or missing.

includeOtherRepos.description: Also list every other public, non-fork repo (fetched live) under All projects.

hideRepos.description: Repo names to leave out when includeOtherRepos is on.

userId.description: Your numeric Discord user ID (Settings → Advanced → Developer Mode, then right-click yourself → Copy User ID). Lanyard needs this; you must be in discord.gg/lanyard.

showStatusOnPfp.description: Small online/idle/dnd dot on your profile picture.

featured.description: Projects in the Featured carousel, in this order. Each entry is a project id from `projects`, one of your repo names ("pronouns"), or "owner/repo". Repos that aren't in `projects` are looked up on GitHub at build time. Remove this list (or leave it empty) to feature the repos pinned on your GitHub profile instead.

initialRows.description: Rows of project cards shown before the "Show more" button.

stack.description: Filter chip groups. Chip labels should match the `tech` names used on projects.

projects.description: Shown in this order. Featured projects go in the carousel; the rest go in the grid.

details.description: Longer text for the detail view. Separate paragraphs with a blank line (\n\n).

image.description: Screenshot path in /public, e.g. "projects/pronouns.png". 16:9 works best.

featured.description: Show in the featured carousel (only used when github.featurePinned is off or pins can't be loaded).

highlight.description: Give it an elevated card in the grid.

hidden.description: Keep it in the file but don't show it.
